list.name: Pipeline Lifecycle Events
list.rawQuery: SELECT event_ts AS time, component || ': ' || event_type AS title, COALESCE(details::text, model_version) AS text FROM eonet_lifecycle_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) ORDER BY event_ts;

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, ROUND(AVG(pred_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS mean_pred_hours, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pred_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS median_pred_hours FROM eonet_predictions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Mean vs. Median Predicted Duration by Model (Hours)

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Tier ' || pred_severity_tier::text AS severity_tier, COUNT(*) AS count FROM eonet_predictions WHERE model_version = 'v3_xgboost' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

defaults.noValue: Awaiting post-cutoff (2026-11-27) hazard closures for live MAE

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', scored_at_utc) AS time, model_version, AVG(abs_error_hours) AS mae_hours FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE actual_duration_hours IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(scored_at_utc) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT model_version, COUNT(*) AS scored_events, ROUND(AVG(pred_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS avg_pred_h, ROUND(MIN(pred_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS min_pred_h, ROUND(MAX(pred_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS max_pred_h, COUNT(abs_error_hours) AS closed_eval_n, ROUND(AVG(abs_error_hours)::numeric, 1) AS live_mae_h FROM eonet_prediction_history GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
